tasks.do: CK-60: nothing is said after a skip, every Cook game. Diagnosis (verify): the read loop asks for its next part after the skip because sayPart is not guarded (js/cook/ui.js:2316, and CHAI-96's :2301), the skip lands on click in js/shared/request-popup.js:356 while UI.say ends the current line on pointerdown (ui.js:513-524), so the loop runs on into the card's 260 ms opening wait (:2268). Fix: sayPart returns at once when skipped or the run changed; the same check after the opening wait; the skip acts on pointerdown; as a backstop, the voice generation taken when the read starts, and any line asked for after it changed is dropped.
tasks.accept: a scripted press of about 250 ms on the kitchen during a headline at L1 and L4, chai tray and one other Cook station: no say-start after the skip-zone note (sound log in the report)

tasks.do: CHAI-104: half or full said in the headline ("Muke adh chai khape") lands its card with the headline, as a style tea's extra does (CHAI-96): the amount row is unsaid (data/cook.json:1221-1249) and js/cook/order.js:302 drops it before the headline's rows are found. Mark the rows the headline says (e.g. saidBy: head), carry it through recipes.js and order.js, keep them in the headline part's rows and in ui.js's folded list despite unsaid; water and tea (CK-51) stay off the order. No card is ever left as a gap when the order passes on.
